'''Rondo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge" /> Endregaad experienced an outbreak of a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly viral disease]], and Rondo accompanied a caraven that departed from the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]] to deliver supplies to families stranded in the [[Temple Valley]] region. On the first night of their journey, Rondo stayed up to guard the caravan's vehicles, and he was attacked and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by several [[Oasis mother|Oasis children]]. The creatures dragged Rondo's corpse away to be fed to their mother, and when the other caravan guards realized that Rondo was missing, a number of them came to suspect that he had stolen some of the caravan's valuables and fled.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
